# Cal Water Names Stuart Skoglund District Manager for Visalia District


September 24, 2026 4:30 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://www.calwatergroup.com/_assets/_50fe26f0901332da3cd31fbe4668a909/calwatergroup/news/2026-09-24_Cal_Water_Names_Stuart_Skoglund_District_Manager_819.pdf)


VISALIA, Calif.—California Water Service (Cal Water) announced today that Stuart Skoglund was selected as the new District Manager of the utility's Visalia operations.


Skoglund, who has been with Cal Water for more than 17 years, has extensive, hands-on knowledge of district operations and water systems. He started his Cal Water career in the Visalia District as a Temporary Laborer in 2009. Since then, Skoglund has held a variety of positions in Cal Water's Selma and Visalia districts including Acting Customer Service Supervisor, Superintendent, and Operations Manager before becoming Interim District Manager for the Visalia District in 2025. As Visalia District Manager, Skoglund also oversees Cal Water's Selma District.


"Stuart's deep knowledge of our operations, strong leadership skills, and commitment to serving our customers make him an excellent choice to lead the Visalia District," said Dan Armendariz, Director of Field Operations, Northern Region. "His experience across multiple areas of the business and dedication to delivering safe, clean, reliable water will help our Visalia customers continue to receive the high quality, service, and value they expect and deserve."


Skoglund holds a Bachelor of Arts degree in General Studies from Southern New Hampshire University. He also holds Water Distribution Grade 5 (D5), Water Treatment Grade 3 (T3), Cross-Connection Control Specialist, and Backflow Tester certifications. He is active in community organizations as a member of the Visalia Breakfast Lions Club and is a past president of the Rotary Club of Selma.


**About California Water Service**


California Water Service provides high-quality, reliable water utility services to about 145,000 people in Visalia through approximately 53,000 service connections; about 25,000 people through more than 6,400 service connections in Selma; and more than 2 million people statewide through 500,000 service connections. Cal Water's purpose is to enhance the quality of life for customers and communities. To do so, it invests responsibly in water and wastewater infrastructure, sustainability initiatives, and community well-being. The company's 1,200 employees live by a set of strong core values and share a commitment to protecting the planet, caring for people, and operating with the utmost integrity. The utility, commemorating a century of service this year, has been named one of "America's Most Responsible Companies" and one of the "World's Most Trustworthy Companies" by *Newsweek* , a USA Top Workplace, and a Great Place to Work®. More information is available at[www.calwater.com](https://www.calwater.com/) .
